THE STARTING POINT

What you can build from here.

A good starting point when…

Developers who want to start with a Foundry-hosted knowledge agent rather than implement a retrieval pipeline from scratch.

  • File-search or AI Search knowledge retrieval with citations.
  • Built-in tracing, monitoring and evaluation examples.
  • Configurable model deployment and retrieval settings.
  • Codespaces, Dev Containers and local development guides.
Before choosing this template

The README offers multiple deployment workflows. Choose one and review its RBAC, model quota and region requirements. This reference sample requires additional security work for production.

FROM EVALUATION TO ACTION

Your next steps, in order.

  1. Review the template and its hooks.

    Inspect repository setup scripts, required permissions and deployment instructions before executing code.

  2. Initialize a new project.

    Use a new directory, then run the template's init command.

    azd init -t get-started-with-ai-agents
    Repository setup instructions ↗

  3. Review costs, then approve deployment.

    Follow the repository guide to authenticate, configure your environment and deploy. Cloud resources can incur charges even after an interrupted deployment. Nothing on this website runs azd up for you.

    Open the Azure pricing calculator ↗

  4. Clean up when you are finished.

    azd down deletes the resources created for an environment. Review the target environment and approve deletion before running it.
